{"proof":"  have hmem (x : ℝ) : x ∈ S ↔ x = 8 ∨ x = -14 := by
    rw [h₀ x]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hs : x + 3 = 11 ∨ x + 3 = -11 := (sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg).mp (by nlinarith : (x + 3) ^ 2 = (11 : ℝ) ^ 2)
      rcases hs with hs | hs
      · left
        linarith
      · right
        linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  have hS : S = ({8, -14} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    simp [hmem x]
  rw [hS]
  simp"}
